title: STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY
officialText:
710.1 Prescriptive requirements. Prescriptive structural integrity requirements of Section 1616
of the New York City Building Code shall be followed for all new structural elements.
710.2 Key Element Analysis. A Key Element Analysis in accordance with Sections 1617 and
1618 of the New York City Building Code shall be performed for the following:
1. Where the alteration meets the requirements of Section 1617.1 of the New York City
Building Code.
2. When the altered building is required to meet the requirements for a new building in
accordance with Section 703.2 of this code, and the altered building meets the requirements
of Section 1617.1 of the New York City Building Code.
3. Altered buildings taller than 7 stories where the work involves transferring a column or a
column transfer removal that supports in aggregate more than 15 percent of the building
area, or where the work involves transferring on 1 element a portion of a wall that portion
of which supports more than 25 percent of the building area. In this case, only the design
and sequence of the transfer and related load path, including the method of load transfer to
the subgrade, shall be subject to key element analysis.
4. When specifically ordered by the commissioner.
